statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Patient has documented history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate cardiac rhythm disturbances with neurological symptoms and dizziness
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific diagnostic procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
